name: 厦门大学
character: The narrow coastal campus sits between mountains and the sea, featuring lush vegetation, complex terrain, a central lake, and Nanyang-style buildings blending Chinese and Western elements.

landmarks.name: 芙蓉湖
landmarks.look: A plain lake at the center of the campus.

landmarks.name: 上弦场
landmarks.quote: 上弦场是位于厦门大学校本部南部的一个体育场。
landmarks.look: A crescent-shaped stadium with 25-tier hillside stands, a 400m track, and three soccer fields.

landmarks.name: 嘉庚广场
landmarks.quote: 2001年，由爱国华侨和厦大校友捐资兴建的嘉庚楼群及嘉庚广场落成。

landmarks.name: 建南楼群
landmarks.quote: 其北侧的建南楼群也于同期建造。
landmarks.look: A plain group of campus buildings on a hill north of the stadium.

landmarks.name: 嘉庚楼群
